description: Figure 8 is a pie chart that visually represents the reduction in time cost achieved through efficient deployment. The chart is divided into two segments. The larger segment, colored light gray, represents the time cost after efficient deployment, which is 26.2 seconds. The smaller segment, colored dark gray, represents the time cost before efficient deployment, which is 60.9 seconds. The chart illustrates that the total time cost is reduced by 69.92% after the implementation of efficient deployment, with the average total time cost dropping from 87.1 seconds to 26.2 seconds.
